correctness.rationale: PASS: In a complete multipartite graph, an induced support in one part consists of isolated vertices, while multi-part supports are connected, so X faces are exactly one-part subsets or subsets of total size<=r. Sorting barycentric coordinates in each part is a continuous fundamental chamber for the partwise symmetric action; the invertible linear tier change t_ij=j(w_ij-w_i,j+1) maps that chamber to a simplex, with max positive tier recovering each part support size. This proves actual PL orbit-space model. Each tier u_i,j>=2 is dominated by u_i,1 since adjoining first tier changes neither support nor max tier. Sequential strong deletions give precisely sk_{r-1} Δ^{s-1}. Its standard integral skeleton matching yields wedge binom(s-1,r) spheres S^{r-1}, including S^0 for r=1 and a point for r>=s. No finite enumeration is needed to bridge to the infinite parameter claim.
